Santander Notification : our new innovative technology
Dear Valued Client Due to our new innovative technology, we have made firewall security, to give standard online banking service to our customers. With the fastest Security and privacy to safeguard you from the fastest account threat. As a result of this you may experience service problems, if you do not upgrade. To get started, Click on the "log on" button to continue. RegardsSantander UK plc.
